evidence_spans: a remarkable conductance enhancement of up to 500% also occurs at a fixed Fermi level of 0.031 eV
a remarkable conductance enhancement of up to 500% also occurs at a fixed Fermi level of 0.031 eV, as shown in the Supplemental Material.
CLM-MAT-0065.statement: At a fixed Fermi level of 0.031 eV, a conductance enhancement of up to 500% occurs.

extra_quotes: We employ a tight-binding approach to analyze GNS [10–12].
We evaluate the conductance by utilizing the Landauer formula [5, 13–15] for the ballistic scattering process

We simulate the GNS system using a tight-binding model with the following parameters: the intralayer coupling between sites A and B is γ 0 = 3.16 eV [16–18], and the interlayer coupling between site A2 (the A site in the second layer) and site B1 (the B site in the first layer) is γ 1 =−0.381 eV.

The only difference is that a mild particle-hole asymmetry is observed in the DFT band structure, because the DFT calculation accounts for additional system details, including higher-order hopping terms, breaking the symmetry.
